name: time-picker-card
author: Georgi Gardev <georgi@gardev.com>
description: Lovelace time-picker-card - a dependency-free, fluid scroll-wheel time picker

scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && node build.mjs
scripts.release-patch: npm version patch && git push origin master --tags
scripts.release-minor: npm version minor && git push origin master --tags
scripts.release-major: npm version major && git push origin master --tags
